newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer sees tough broadcast comparisons.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer sees tough broadcast comparisons.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Co said Thursday it expects to benefit in 1997 from lower average newsprint prices, but it expects its broadcasting segment will be hit with steep revenue comparisons.

"Looking forward in 1997, while publishing operations should benefit from lower average newsprint prices, our broadcasting segment will face tough revenue comparisons, particularly in the second half of the year, because political and Olympics-related advertising was up substantially in 1996," Michael Pulitzer, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
